content: ArgoCD self-management: app-of-apps root Application must be applied manually once (documented bootstrap step); finalizers (resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io) cause cascading child-resource deletion — dangerous when accidental, but required if you want delete-from-git to tear down; auto-sync+prune+selfHeal on the ArgoCD app itself can fight manual recovery during outages. Homelab exposure: never expose ArgoCD/NPM/Proxmox admin UIs publicly — constant bot scanning; use VPN/Tailscale or SSO gate (oauth2-proxy/Authelia/Zitadel) for anything public. k3s single node: components (etcd/sqlite, traefik, metrics) consume ~1-2GB; reserve headroom, disable unused bundled components. Sources: octopus/codefresh finalizer posts, sofianedjerbi argocd-manage-itself, homelab security guides.
